seoDescription: What to expect at your first physical therapy visit at Fox Valley Physical Therapy in Oshkosh, WI. No referral needed. Download the intake form.
heroText: We do things differently. Every appointment is hands-on and one-on-one with your therapist.
stepsTitle: Your First Visit, Step By Step

steps.title: Call To Schedule
steps.text: No referral needed — our office will check your insurance benefits for you.

steps.title: Fill Out Your Intake Form
steps.text: Download it below and bring it to your first visit, or come a few minutes early.

steps.title: Your Evaluation
steps.text: Your therapist reviews your history, tests how you move, and explains what's going on.

steps.title: Your Treatment Plan
steps.text: A plan built for you, with hands-on treatment and a home program to keep you improving.

formText: Print it, fill it out at home, and bring it to your first appointment. You can also fill one out at the front desk.
evalPoints: Your history, to understand how and when the problem started
An exam of how you move and how your joints are working
Measurements of muscle strength, nerve function, and pain levels
A clear explanation of what we found and what we recommend, shared with you and your doctor
evalText: Wear comfortable clothes you can move in. Sessions run from 30 minutes to two hours, depending on what you need.
ctaText: Call our Oshkosh clinic to schedule your first visit. You don't need a referral.
